messages:
Rae (CS): FYI: BeaconHealth goes live Tue. Theyre demoing an assistant that receives lots of micro-edits. We need a short external-facing ops sheet: prefill guidance, debounce, streaming UX, cache key hygiene, and renewal trigger rules. Draft below.
Hector (SRE): Ops constraints: demo traffic bursts, want interactive feel but must cap cost. Recommend warmup + session caps.
Maya (AE): Budget-sensitive customer. Renewal will hinge on cost per visit. Put an early-warning for finance and AE.
Liam (DevEx): For client UX: prefer streaming with a visible "in progress" state and an explicit accept action to finalize. Also recommend client-side 250ms debounce.
Rae (CS): Customer-facing ops sheet (bullet list):
- Prefill: we will seed top 8 user journeys via prefill API. Keep templates <=200 tokens to maximize cache hits.
- Warm pool: reserve 1 GPU for 48h and run a 40-session warm script pre-launch.
- Streaming: enable chunked streaming; render partials but require a /confirm-finalize call from client to commit result to downstream systems.
- Debounce: recommend 200-300ms client debounce on keystroke edits; coalesce identical rapid edits.
- Cache keys: use stable key = sha1(tenant + template_id + normalized_prefix). Avoid including volatile session ids. TTL = 6h.
- Cost guardrails: per-session token cap = 10k tokens; daily account cap = $300 (AE + finance notified at 120% of forecast).
- Fallbacks: automatic model downgrade to quantized variant when util > 68% for 2m or p95 > 1s for 5m. Also halve batch size on fallback.
- Telemetry: emit token_count, model_variant, latency_ms, cache_hit, route, and user_action. Hook to AE dashboard.
- Escalation: oncall SRE, EngOps, AE contact list in Confluence runbook.
Hector (SRE): Ops snippet for EngOps (add to Confluence):
```json
{
  "tenant": "beaconhealth",
  "warm_pool": {"gpus": 1, "duration": "48h"},
  "cache": {"strategy": "prefix", "ttl_seconds": 21600, "key_hash": "sha1(tenant+template)"},
  "guards": {"session_token_cap": 10000, "daily_cost_cap_usd": 300},
  "fallback": {"trigger_util_pct": 68, "trigger_window_sec": 120, "action": "switch:quantized"}
}
```
Maya (AE): Renewal play: weekly digest with spend, avg cost/visit, and top journeys. If 3-day avg cost/visit > target by 25% we schedule a cost review with CS + SRE + customer.
Rae (CS): Ill produce a one-page PDF for the customer, a detailed Confluence ops doc with commands, and an AE email template for cost alerts. Tagging this thread for the handoff.
